import sys

    grid = [[c - 48 for c in data[2 + i]] for i in range(n)]

    for _ in range(q):
        # Matriz com borda morta (dimensao (n+2) x (n+2)) para evitar checagens de limites
        p = [[0] * (n + 2)] + [[0] + row + [0] for row in grid] + [[0] * (n + 2)]

            up, cur, dn = p[i], p[i + 1], p[i + 2]
            new_row = [0] * n
            for j in range(n):
                cnt = (up[j] + up[j + 1] + up[j + 2] +
                       cur[j] + cur[j + 2] +
                       dn[j] + dn[j + 1] + dn[j + 2])
                if cur[j + 1]:
                    new_row[j] = 1 if (cnt == 2 or cnt == 3) else 0
                else:
                    new_row[j] = 1 if cnt == 3 else 0
            new_grid.append(new_row)
